Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE FIXED EMPTY landscape16:9 background plate, approximately1672x941, for CANCEL CITY Daenerys Airfryer CC135 Dracarys Preheat. Supplied card is ONLY the exact rough etched neon style reference; no queen, dragon or fryer from it.
Scene: absurd royal COUNTERTOP THRONE ROOM: a shabby grand medieval stone hall repurposed into a kitchen throne room. At far back center an EMPTY dark angular royal chair on a low dais, kept small and distant. Tall pointed stone arches, tarnished chain details and grimy vaulted beams. At both far sides, waist-high scuffed dark stainless cooking COUNTERS with wide empty tops and blank unlit rectangular control-panel spaces, cupboards underneath. Broad uninterrupted dark-grey flagstone floor fills lower half, perfectly clear center and left foreground for an acting queen. Consistent waist-height perspective and level combat plane. Do not put a table, island, chair, prop or counter across the foreground.
Color/lighting: acid yellow-green strip lighting hidden along stone arches and counter edges, vivid magenta shadows, deep black ink, small cyan metallic highlights. Dense harsh scratched black etching, crosshatching, stippling and grungy lurid cheap-print card texture matching reference. Not smooth fantasy painting, polished anime background, clean vector,3D or photorealistic.
STRICT completely EMPTY environment: no queen, human, creature, silhouette, dragon, dragon statue, dragon ornament, air fryer, appliance on counters, timer display, bowl, food, flame, fire, smoke, steam, magic, dust, particles, projectile or effects. Countertops empty. No text, letters, numbers, logos, banners with symbols, labels, captions, watermark or card border. One stable fixed scene for repeated compositing, with ample central acting space and side counters.
